text_blocks.snippet: No, the Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon, and it is very hard to see even from low Earth orbit.
Why it is hard to see:

list.title: Too narrow
list.snippet: Most sections are less than 10 metres wide, about the width of a road.

list.title: Blends in
list.snippet: It is built from local stone and earth, so its colour matches the land around it.

list.title: Astronaut reports
list.snippet: China's first astronaut, Yang Liwei, said he could not see it from orbit.

text_blocks.snippet: Astronauts have photographed parts of the wall from the space station using long camera lenses.

references.title: Is China's Great Wall Visible from Space?
